# Independent audit of the dimension-uniform three-cap vacancy theorem

Source: `candidate b02f449107e522a5`. Full independent read: PASS in its stated n=1, d>=4 scope. It extends the actual geometric vacancy implication, not the all-menu capacity obstruction itself.

The shared zero barycentric minima of D_delta and T imply nonnegative coordinate minima for every real fiber to the right, so all such fibers lie in T. The R minimum/maximum contradiction correctly excludes every sampled base below -1. The Beta(d-1,2) volume integral is d delta^(d-1)-(d-1)delta^d, and its bound by d/5^(d-1)<=4/125 is correct. The exposed endpoint cannot reach the middle centroid's Gamma_d V lower bound.

The smooth source-adjacency input is used only to locate any second source at base1. Actual strict source exclusion and zero outside strip coarea then force the three whole-fiber misses there. Adding the opposite-base margin constraints and using the edge vertex in D gives exactly lambda_i<=2/(d+1)+2eta=21/[10(d+1)]. Positive rescaling of the cap equation tracks its smoothing width and does not change this inference. Since this bound is below one half, support concavity excludes base2. No exposure along a higher-dimensional line is substituted for global exposure.

The three-coordinate inclusion-exclusion upper bound is valid even when the triple intersection is nonempty: omitting its nonnegative subtraction only enlarges the bound. For F_c(x)=(1-c/(x+1))^x, direct differentiation followed by the convergent power series gives the displayed coefficient c^(k-1)[c(1-1/k)-1] for every k>=2. It is nonnegative for c>=2. Thus A_d>=(29/50)^4 is correct uniformly in d.

The B_d exponent bound is also strict: the difference between -4d/(d+1)-8d/(d+1)^2 and -4 equals -4(d-1)/(d+1)^2<0. The inequalities e>8/3 and (8/3)^4>50 give B_d<1/50. The exact rational volume ceiling 4503157/6250000 is correct and is below8/11.

For completeness, the elementary e<11/4 bound used in the source follows from

    e < 1+1+1/2+1/6 + (1/24)/(1-1/5)
      =87/32 <11/4.

The strict geometric tail bound is valid because consecutive reciprocal-factorial ratios after the fourth term are at most1/5, and at least one is strictly smaller. Hence Gamma_d>=1/e>4/11 supplies the required dimension-uniform gap.

After the exposure conclusion, every sampled fiber is contained in T. The within-fiber lambda_2 variances are at most1/4, so the actual pooled covariance width is at most h/2. The d-simplex lambda_2 density is bounded by dV, giving slab mass at most dhV and one own smoothed cap of mass at most|K1|/2+dhV/2. The stated restriction h<1/(1000d) leaves a strict rational margin below4V/11: the exact unused gap 465273/137500000 is larger than1/2000. A finite base tilt isolates that cap because K1 is globally exposed among sampled fibers. This proves the contradiction at the actual smoothed depth level.

No numerical computation, omitted boundary mass, or unproved continuous-to-discrete replacement enters the argument. The source correctly states that the conclusion does not directly extend along arbitrary primitive lines when n>1, because the final exposed-fiber depth estimate is global.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
